title: Attention Is All You Need / Transformer
summary: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Lukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin submitted Attention Is All You Need to arXiv on June 12, 2017, proposing the Transformer, a sequence-transduction architecture based solely on attention mechanisms without recurrence or convolution.
significance: A documented architecture milestone introducing the Transformer described in the original paper.

verification.note: Title, authors, June 12, 2017 v1 submission date, and the paper's proposal of the Transformer architecture based solely on attention mechanisms are verified against the original arXiv record. The date is explicitly treated as the arXiv submission milestone, not as a separate system-birth or conference-publication date. No geography, institutional affiliation, ancestry, influence, or causal relationship is inferred.
